title: Port the live Engram root-recovery / named-root-completion test fixtures to post-gating Engram (no turn_gated init, authority store key established through the ordinary path)
outcome: The ignored live tests in src/tests/engram_root_recovery_live.rs and src/tests/engram_named_root_completion_live.rs set up a real pinned post-gating Engram, and the project's Engram authority store key, through the ordinary non-gated path. Their witness bodies then actually execute against a current pinned Engram.
acceptance: The shared live fixtures use only commands the pinned post-gating Engram (0fe6348 or later) accepts, and establish the project's authority_store_key (and anything else the witnesses read) through the ordinary non-gated route, with no turn_gated or action_gated policy; shown by a cited source search.

Each live test either reaches its witness body and passes once on the approved pinned Engram, or is deleted with a recorded reason and cited ordinary-EO coverage; no gating is reintroduced and no witness assertion is weakened.

The c437 registration-revision witness (registration_refreshes_after_revision_or_child_attachment_but_never_after_registration) passes once live on the pinned Engram, closing the live evidence deferred from w-c43760ef6a60.
